description: A synthetic-only flagged occurrence has zero weight, so the canonical competing reading remains c (engine §7.10).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution leftmost-longest #(·w ∪ ·c ∪ ·d ∪ ·empty), late #·<_Elided>
%elision-only
%rule text (w ≻ missing) | c | d
%rule w (X [+T]) | ([+U] X)
               
%rule missing (M N)
%rule c (X T)
               
%rule d (X empty)
               
%rule empty T
